newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia 1996 GDP seen down 6.0 pct yr/yr--committee.
newsitem.headline: Russia 1996 GDP seen down 6.0 pct yr/yr--committee.

text.p: The Russian economy economy shrank by six percent this year, the chairman of the State Statistics Committee said on Monday.
"The general level of production as measured by gross domestic product (GDP) fell by six percent for the year. For comparison, it fell by four percent last year," Yuri Yurkov told a news conference.
He said industrial output fell by five percent for the year. It fell three percent in 1995.
"The biggest fall (in 1996) was in agriculture, industry and commodity turnover," he said.
